title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: intelligent summaries of Copilot adoption trends
summary: The briefing's rollout, default state, licensing and documented controls are supported by Microsoft's notice and Learn. Minor corrections should clarify the feature selection and finish the individual-access route; the governance checklist also refers to an access control absent from the table.

claims.claim: The web app access-policy route is Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting > On or Off in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote:
3. Select Create a policy.
4. Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy.
5. Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.
claims.fix: After 'Create a policy', explicitly include the app and feature selection before 'Access setting', using lower-case placeholders: 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app > feature > Access setting > On or Off'. Keep the note selecting the Viva Insights web app. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates the tenant web-app disable policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.where: Governance controls: individual user and group access path
claims.claim: Individual access is managed at Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users or Groups.
claims.quote:
At the top, select Users. Search for the people you'd like to add, and select them from the list.
2. At the bottom, select Add.
claims.fix: Finish the route for adding access: 'Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users or Groups > Add', noting that the people or groups are selected before Add. For removal, end with 'Users > Remove selected users' or 'Groups > Remove selected groups'. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/admin/manage-settings-copilot-dashboard.

claims.where: Governance controls: individual user and group access

claims.quote: You can turn access to the Viva Insights web app on or off for individual users or groups using Microsoft Entra ID.
